title: Yarn plug-n-play linker in use
description: .yarnrc.yml declares a `nodeLinker: pnp` setting. Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a `nodeLinker: pnp` setting.
remediation: Regenerate the artifact with integrity data enabled and commit the recorded digest or checksum. Specifically: fix a `nodeLinker: pnp` setting.
limitation: It matches a `nodeLinker: pnp` setting in the parsed .yarnrc.yml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
